cctlive.attached: [cct-live] An AI has taken control of computer %s (lease %s s; /cctlive detach %s takes it back)
cctlive.expired: [cct-live] The AI's lease on computer %s expired; released
cctlive.removed: [cct-live] Computer %s was removed; the AI's control ended
cctlive.revoked: [cct-live] Took control of computer %s back from the AI
cctlive.list.none: [cct-live] No computer is controlled by an AI
cctlive.list.entry: [cct-live] Computer %s: controlled by an AI, lease ends in %s s
cctlive.detach.none: [cct-live] Computer %s is not controlled by an AI
cctlive.unavailable: [cct-live] Computer %s is no longer loaded or available; the AI control ended
